meaning: Vendor documentation pages that state the exact method and path of a route AMCP maps, with the date each was read (ARC-03). An entry anchors its route as documented_url in generated/route-anchors.json. tools/route-anchors.ts refuses an entry whose method and path no longer match its route, or that names no routed ledger action. Add pages only from primary vendor documentation you read; a captured listing is not documentation.

routes.note: Apply an authorization code: advertiser_id, auth_code (a '+' is written '%2B') and original_post_auth_code; the answer's data is empty (src/tiktok-tt-video-authorize.ts).
Unbind a Spark Ad post: advertiser_id and item_id, after the authorization has expired or has been revoked; the answer's data is empty (src/tiktok-tt-video-unbind.ts).

Get Spark Ad posts: advertiser_id, item_types, keyword, page and page_size (1-50); each row carries the post's auth_code, which the read-back of an applied authorization matches by digest (src/tiktok-tt-video-list.ts).
q=creative&creative={sponsoredCreativeUrn}&account={sponsoredAccountUrn}; preview iframe sources are valid up to 3 hours (src/linkedin-ad-previews.ts).
Ad Rules Engine, API Calls: POST /{ad_rule_id} updates a rule (src/meta-rule-routes.ts).
Ad Rules Engine, API Calls: DELETE /{ad_rule_id} deletes a rule (src/meta-rule-routes.ts).

Creatives reference, Tweet Previews: tweet_ids (required, comma-separated, up to 200) and tweet_type (required: DRAFT, PUBLISHED, SCHEDULED); the answer is data, one {tweet_id, preview} per Tweet, the preview an iframe whose src is on ton.twimg.com (docs/records/X-TWEET-PREVIEWS-PIN-2026-11-16.md; src/x-ad-previews.ts).
